title: Grid 5 versus Grid 10 with Grid plus Ratio queries
experiment_type: User-requested query-strategy parameter experiment; no algorithm code optimization or code-default change. The prior Grid-10 benchmark baseline is unchanged.

existing_tests.scope: The identical 87 Python files were already validated on both platforms before the preceding experiment; documentation-only commit changes since those tests. No algorithm code or test changes for this experiment.

source.note: Grid-size change explicitly requested as a strategy experiment; other settings and saved inputs fixed. No repository changes or profiler active.

protocol.order: Sequential fresh processes; alternate Grid 10/Grid 5 order by repeat and problem ordinal.
protocol.timing_scope: Unchanged solve_problem wall time includes session/worker startup and shutdown, state analyses, planning and progress output; imports, parsing and report writing excluded. Common pool-shutdown PID observer overhead unquantified.
protocol.question_timer_scope: State analysis before the question and query planning. Total time divided by question count is descriptive, not the isolated cost of evaluating identical states.

inputs.origin: Exact ten primary 5x5 inputs from previous benchmarks; no new RNG draws.

previous_grid10_semantic_comparison.timing_caveat: Historical wall times are not used to estimate the paired Grid-size effect.

prior_test_evidence.scope: 228 Multi-Step tests on Mac and 228 on Bench i7 before the preceding experiment, against these identical 87 Python file hashes. No new suite run for this Grid-size experiment.

mac_receipt.scope: Complete multistep suite after guarded grid prefilter parity change plus four new regression tests.

raw_artifacts.query_trajectory_scope: All chosen queries, answers, expected values and candidate-volume trajectories in 60 raw reports; nonchosen recursive branches not recorded.

decision.interpretation: Grid 5 is promising for this workload: faster and no observed selected-utility loss. Its different query strategy is not established as universally noninferior.

limitations: Ten unique cases from one seed; repeats only improve timing and do not create 30 independent quality cases.
The 99-percent volume rule is not a universal guarantee of correct selection for every target weight.
Both sizes retain exact geometric volume computation, but Grid 5 changes query selection and later states.
No phase profiling or formal statistical noninferiority test; historical wall times not used for the paired speed comparison.
compact_schema_note: Per-case fields omit derivable duplicate values. Full per-case timer ranges, first-question timers, query hashes and terminal fields remain in the hashed full comparison.json and raw files. Each target-utility reference is shared by both sizes.
source_metadata_clarification: The copied frozen provenance flag default_grid_size_unchanged:10 refers to the agreed benchmark reference configuration, not the repository code default. The actual DEFAULT_GRID_SIZE and exact-end-to-end CLI/build_config/solve default are 21; all code defaults remain unchanged. Measurements explicitly used Grid 10 and Grid 5.
